text: Bless every one of your mistakes. Do not criticize yourself, do not blame, do not punish... Accept all your past experience with love and gratitude. Each of your mistakes, each failure is not a miss, but a manifestation of your inner wisdom, which corrected your course when you got too carried away and were going the wrong way or trying to stay in place. Do not regret the past. Instead, thank every supposedly wrong step of yours, understanding that it was precisely these steps that gave you real experience of development and the wisdom growing from it!
